prev_agent: <proposed_plan> **Sandcastle Per-User Tailscale DNS** **Summary** Implement Sandcastle DNS without MagicDNS or Tailscale split DNS. Each Mac uses macOS `/etc/resolver/<instance>` to send Sandcastle instance DNS queries directly to the user’s Tailscale sidecar IP. Target hostname format: ```text <sandbox>.<project>.<sandcastle-instance-name> ``` Example: ```text api.billing.castlebox ``` For sandboxes without a project: ```text <sandbox>.sandboxes.<sandcastle-instance-name> ``` Example: ```text scratch.sandboxes.castlebox ``` **Architecture** - Run a DNS resolver per user alongside that user’s existing Tailscale sidecar/network. - Keep Rails as the source of truth for DNS records. - Publish only records for active sandboxes that are connected to that user’s Tailscale network and have a current IP from `TailscaleManager#sandbox_tailscale_ip`. - Use macOS `/etc/resolver/<instance>` on clients: ```text nameserver <user-sidecar-tailscale-ip> ``` - No `/etc/hosts`, no MagicDNS, no Tailscale split DNS. **Implementation Changes** - Add a Rails DNS publisher service that writes a per-user hosts file atomically, for example: ```text /data/users/<user>/dns/hosts ``` with content like: ```text 10.42.18.7 api.billing.castlebox 10.42.18.8 worker.billing.castlebox 10.42.18.9 scratch.sandboxes.castlebox ``` - Add a DNS process to the per-user Tailscale sidecar setup. Prefer CoreDNS, either as: - a sibling container attached to `sc-ts-net-<user>`, or - a bundled process in a custom Sandcastle Tailscale/DNS image. - Use CoreDNS `hosts` plugin with short TTL and reload: ```text castlebox:53 { hosts /data/dns/hosts { ttl 15 reload 5s fallthrough } } ``` - Ensure the resolver is reachable at the sidecar’s Tailscale IP on port `53`. - Add DNS regeneration triggers after sandbox provision/start/stop/destroy/archive, sandbox rename, Tailscale connect/disconnect, and container sync reconciliation. - Add a periodic reconciliation job that republishes every user’s DNS hosts file to heal missed events. - Add API/status support returning: - instance suffix - user sidecar Tailscale IP - resolver status - published records - skipped records and reasons **CLI UX** - Add: ```bash sandcastle dns status sandcastle dns install sandcastle dns uninstall ``` - `sandcastle dns status` …
